# Azure DevOps Project Defaults

Configure the default Azure DevOps values used when a request to create a user story does not specify them.

| Field | Default value |
| --- | --- |
| Project | Not configured |
| Area Path | Not configured |
| Iteration Path | Not configured |

Replace each `Not configured` value with the Azure DevOps value to use. The user-story workflow must ask the user when a required default is not configured.
